question: Eight people, A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H, are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. Only one person sits between A and B when counted from the left of A. E sits to the immediate right of B. Only two people sit between E and F when counted from the left of E. C sits third to the left of F. D sits to the immediate right of H. Who sits second to the right of G?
solution:
**Given:**

Eight people A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.

Only one person sits between A and B when counted from the left of A.

E sits to the immediate right of B.

Only two people sit between E and F when counted from the left of E.

C sits third to the left of F.

D sits to the immediate right of H.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f5da6690ca9bb02bd45ae1b3850584c78b8a95e370bc61aa44412fdbcd8260b4.png] 

Facing centre ⇒ right means anticlockwise.

From G:

1st right → D

2nd right → E

Therefore, the person sitting second to the right of G is **E**.

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 3**.
